0022600097.text: The Toronto Raptors, 1-0 and second in the Atlantic, visit the Washington Wizards, who are also 1-0 and second in the Southeast, as both teams look to stay unbeaten. Toronto is without Brandon Ingram (heel, surgery) and Nate Bittle (foot), while Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), and Felix Okpara (illness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 134-125 win in Washington on February 28, 2026, and the teams have not met yet this season.
